content.text: Using SST to hold the pulley, install and torque the pulley bolt.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool holding oil pump drive pulley during installation

content.text: Using SST and hammer, drive in the pulley.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool and hammer being used to drive in crankshaft timing pulley

content.text: 3. TEMPORARILY INSTALL IDLER PULLEY AND TENSION SPRING
Push the idler pulley toward the alternator side as far as it will go and temporarily tighten it.
4. TEMPORARILY INSTALL TIMING BELT ON CRANKSHAFT TIMING PULLEY

items: (a) Check the rotation direction mark placed on the timing belt during disassembly.
(b) Install the timing belt on the crankshaft timing pulley.

content.description: Illustration showing idler pulley and tension spring installation with timing belt

items: (a) Install the crankshaft pulley and pulley bolt.
(b) Using SST to hold the crankshaft pulley, torque the pulley bolt.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tools being used to hold crankshaft pulley during torque application

content.text: 8. REMOVE OIL FILLER CAP AND CYLINDER HEAD COVER OF EXHAUST SIDE
9. INSTALL CAMSHAFT TIMING PULLEY AND TIMING BELT

items: (a) Make sure that the match hole on the No. 2 journal of the camshaft housing is aligned with that of the camshaft.
If not aligned, temporarily install the camshaft timing pulley and insert the match pin into the hole.
Then, align the match holes by turning the camshaft timing pulley.

content.description: Illustration showing alignment of match holes between camshaft housing journal and camshaft, with detail view of EX and IN sides
